mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration and economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth above 105.0 (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic fundamentals, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy that depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly payroll decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increase (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200.0 (HOUST) during housing recovery signals strengthening consumer confidence and economic growth, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.
